subject: E-3196: TLS handshake failed on macOS
body:
Hello support team. We run MeshMail 2.8.8 on macOS 14.7. Since the weekend,
every time I open the app, I get 'E-3196: TLS handshake failed'.

A dead motherboard battery reset the system clock to a wrong date. The login
page in the browser also shows a cretificate warning.

Before writing in I tried reboooting the router; same error afterwards.

Daniel Ortega -- Harbour Freight. Appreciate any pointers.
